title_en: The Book's Empty Margin: The Record

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: There is a receipt for the boards. Tovin's mark beside the clerk's.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I cannot say I did not know what my hand did.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: You can stop asking the paper to take the blame.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: This copy stays intact. We will put your account beside it, not over it.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: Write that I signed. Write that I was paid.
Mera sets a clean sheet beside the damaged one. For once, the second account does not replace the first.
